title: Home Solar
description: Fox ESS solar, battery and grid, from foxess_exporter

panels.title: Where the power is going right now
panels.description: Moving arrows show which way power is flowing; thicker arrows mean more power. Battery flows of $battery_noise_w W or less and grid flows under 30 W are hidden as measurement noise. Arrows into the inverter from the grid mean buying, out to the grid mean selling.

targets.expr: ((sqrt(clamp_min(-(foxess_grid_ct_power_watts * (abs(foxess_grid_ct_power_watts) > bool 30)), 0)) + 15 * (clamp_min(-(foxess_grid_ct_power_watts * (abs(foxess_grid_ct_power_watts) > bool 30)), 0) > bool 20))) or on() vector(0)

((sqrt(clamp_min((foxess_grid_ct_power_watts * (abs(foxess_grid_ct_power_watts) > bool 30)), 0)) + 15 * (clamp_min((foxess_grid_ct_power_watts * (abs(foxess_grid_ct_power_watts) > bool 30)), 0) > bool 20))) or on() vector(0)

((sqrt(clamp_min(-(foxess_battery_power_watts * (abs(foxess_battery_power_watts) > bool $battery_noise_w)), 0)) + 15 * (clamp_min(-(foxess_battery_power_watts * (abs(foxess_battery_power_watts) > bool $battery_noise_w)), 0) > bool 20))) or on() vector(0)

((sqrt(clamp_min((foxess_battery_power_watts * (abs(foxess_battery_power_watts) > bool $battery_noise_w)), 0)) + 15 * (clamp_min((foxess_battery_power_watts * (abs(foxess_battery_power_watts) > bool $battery_noise_w)), 0) > bool 20))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: 🔋 Battery level
panels.description: How full the battery is. It stops discharging at the minimum level set on the inverter.

panels.title: 🔋 Battery is…
panels.description: Charging = storing spare energy. Powering home = the battery is supplying the house.

panels.title: ⚡ Grid
panels.description: Buying = importing from the grid (costs money). Selling = exporting spare solar.

panels.title: ✅ System
panels.description: Whether the exporter can reach the inverter, whether mains power is on, and any inverter faults.

panels.title: ☀️ Solar made
panels.description: Energy the panels generated today.

panels.title: 🏠 Home used
panels.description: Everything the house used today.

panels.title: ⚡ Bought
panels.description: Energy imported (paid for) today.

panels.title: 💷 Sold
panels.description: Spare solar exported today.

panels.title: 🌱 Self-powered
panels.description: Self-sufficiency: share of today's home energy that came from your own solar and battery instead of the grid. Shows — until the house has used 0.5 kWh.

panels.title: ♻️ Solar kept
panels.description: Self-consumption: share of today's solar used in the house or stored in the battery, rather than sold to the grid. Shows — until 0.5 kWh of solar.

panels.title: 💰 Saved today
panels.description: Energy you didn't have to buy (at the import price) plus export earnings (at the export price). Set your tariff in the dashboard variables at the top.

panels.title: Where the power is flowing
panels.description: Above the zero line, Battery and Grid are supplying the house. Below it, the battery is charging and spare solar is being sold to the grid.

panels.title: Battery level
panels.description: How full the battery has been. The dashed line is the reserve it won't go below.

panels.title: Solar made each day
panels.description: Daily solar generation for each completed day.

panels.title: Where the home's energy came from each day
panels.description: Each bar is a completed day's total home use, split by where it came from.

panels.title: ☀️ Solar made
panels.description: Generated since the 1st.

panels.title: 🏠 Home used
panels.description: House use since the 1st.

panels.title: ⚡ Bought from grid
panels.description: Imported since the 1st.

panels.title: 💷 Sold to grid
panels.description: Exported since the 1st.

panels.title: 🌱 Self-powered
panels.description: Share of this month's home energy not bought from the grid.

targets.expr: clamp_min((1 - ((sum(sum_over_time(max_over_time(foxess_grid_import_energy_today_kwh[22h])[$__range:1d])) or vector(0)) + sum(foxess_grid_import_energy_today_kwh)) / ((sum(sum_over_time(max_over_time(foxess_load_energy_today_kwh[22h])[$__range:1d])) or vector(0)) + sum(foxess_load_energy_today_kwh))) * 100, 0) and ((sum(sum_over_time(max_over_time(foxess_load_energy_today_kwh[22h])[$__range:1d])) or vector(0)) + sum(foxess_load_energy_today_kwh)) >= 0.5

panels.title: 💰 Saved
panels.description: This month's saving at your tariff.

targets.expr: clamp_min(((sum(sum_over_time(max_over_time(foxess_load_energy_today_kwh[22h])[$__range:1d])) or vector(0)) + sum(foxess_load_energy_today_kwh)) - ((sum(sum_over_time(max_over_time(foxess_grid_import_energy_today_kwh[22h])[$__range:1d])) or vector(0)) + sum(foxess_grid_import_energy_today_kwh)), 0) * $import_price + ((sum(sum_over_time(max_over_time(foxess_grid_export_energy_today_kwh[22h])[$__range:1d])) or vector(0)) + sum(foxess_grid_export_energy_today_kwh)) * $export_price

panels.title: ☀️ Solar made
panels.description: Total generated since install.

panels.title: 🏠 Home used
panels.description: Total house use since install.

panels.title: 💷 Sold to grid
panels.description: Total exported since install.

panels.title: 🌱 Self-powered
panels.description: Share of all home energy since install that didn't come from the grid.

panels.title: 🌍 CO₂ avoided
panels.description: Solar generated × grid carbon intensity (set in the dashboard variables).

panels.title: 💰 Saved
panels.description: Rough lifetime saving at today's tariff (set in the dashboard variables).

panels.title: Battery charging and discharging
panels.description: Above zero: the battery is supplying the house. Below zero: it's charging.

panels.title: Battery temperature
panels.description: Warmest/coolest cell are the actual cell temperatures. The pack sensor sits elsewhere in the battery (likely the control board) and usually reads warmer. Lithium cells are happiest between about 15 and 30 °C.

panels.title: Health
panels.description: Capacity compared with new (100% = as new).

panels.title: Stored now
panels.description: Energy in the battery right now (capacity × charge level).

panels.title: Capacity
panels.description: How much the battery holds when full. Falls slowly as it ages.

panels.title: Round-trip efficiency
panels.description: Energy got back out of the battery for every unit put in, since install. 85–95% is typical; it reads low until the battery has done a few full cycles.

panels.title: Battery has earned
panels.description: Since install: energy the battery supplied (valued at the import price) minus what it stored (valued at the export price you'd otherwise have earned).

panels.title: Cell voltage
panels.description: Highest and lowest cell voltage (0.1 V resolution). A widening gap between them means the cells are drifting out of balance.

panels.title: Power per panel string
panels.description: Each string is a separate run of panels, e.g. different roof faces.

panels.title: Voltage per string
panels.description: Panel string voltage. Near zero at night.

panels.title: Current per string
panels.description: Panel string current.

panels.title: Inverter
panels.description: Inverter model.

panels.title: Firmware
panels.description: Inverter firmware versions.

panels.title: Work mode
panels.description: Self use: power the house first, then charge the battery, then export.

panels.title: Fault registers
panels.description: Raw inverter fault bitmasks. Anything other than 0 means the inverter is reporting a fault.

panels.title: Exporter read time
panels.description: How long each Modbus read of the inverter takes.

panels.title: Grid voltage
panels.description: UK mains is 230 V, allowed range 216–253 V.

panels.title: Grid frequency
panels.description: Nominal 50 Hz.

panels.title: Inverter AC side
panels.description: Inverter AC power, backup (EPS) output and the second CT clamp.

panels.title: Battery current
panels.description: Battery current as seen by the inverter and by the battery itself.

panels.title: Active alarms
panels.description: Named inverter alarms from the Fox protocol.

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: Battery modules and rated capacity.

panels.title: Grid limits
panels.description: Maximum power the inverter will export to, or import from, the grid.

panels.title: Forced grid charging
panels.description: Time slots when the inverter charges the battery from the grid (e.g. on a cheap overnight tariff).

panels.title: Control
panels.description: Whether something external is controlling the inverter, and whether the grid meter is connected.
